title: Level 1 — On-orbit servicing
subtitle: Repair a satellite that lost a solar panel and its antenna
briefing: The reference satellite orbits at 480 km, like Hubble today. It lost a solar panel and its high-gain antenna.
Your servicing vehicle starts at 400 km. Climb with transfer maneuvers (delta-V) and dock.
Cargo is limited: every kilogram of tools reduces the available delta-V (Tsiolkovsky equation).
Repairs only progress while the ground station is in view (communication window).
objectives: Reach within ±2 km of the satellite's altitude without running out of fuel.
Replace the solar panel and the antenna within the mission time.
